# 总体与性能

_Overall Engine Performance_

从发动机类型、热力循环和任务需求出发，理解性能指标与部件匹配。

_Start with engine configurations, thermodynamic cycles and mission requirements, then connect performance measures to component matching._

## 阅读建议 / Study Approach

先读专题导读，再查原始资料；把概念、工况和证据范围一起记录。

_Read the topic notes, then consult the original material. Keep concepts, operating conditions and the scope of evidence together._
